name: Iris Burst
description: Colored circles or diamonds burst out from a point to cover the frame, then open a hole from the same point to reveal the next shot.
useWhen: Playful, graphic cuts between scenes: from a clicked button to the next screen (set the origin to the click), between chapters, into a title card. Put it on a track above both clips and center it on the cut (from = cut frame − half its length).

rings.label: Two rings
rings.help: An accent ring leads the main color in and trails it out.
